status: frozen before any real price data is seen; supersedes v1 for every new run; v1, amendments A1/A2, c1-c4 candidates and all their results are kept unchanged

universe.rule: 8 US-listed pairs fixed a priori by a shared economic driver; no pair may be added, dropped or replaced after data are seen; every pair is tested in every window and reported

pairs.rationale: iShares Australia vs Canada country ETFs; both commodity-exporting developed markets
gold miners equity ETF vs physical gold ETF; operating leverage makes the link loose (expected weak)
E&P equal-weight ETF vs cap-weight energy sector ETF
control: two ETFs on the same S&P 500 index; cointegration expected by construction of the products, spread expected smaller than costs

universe.search_count_note: 8 pairs x every walk-forward window are all counted as tests; no other pair was tested on this data. One interface probe (EWA chart request, 2026-10-10) preceded this freeze and is logged; no statistic was computed from it.

sample.calendar: NYSE trading days as the union of dates returned for all 16 tickers; a date missing for any held/traded ticker is a data error, never forward-filled
sample.source: Yahoo Finance chart endpoint (see data_manifest.json for terms review and field semantics)

prices.trade_prices: split-unadjusted open/close reconstructed from vendor split-adjusted quotes using vendor split events; dividend-unadjusted
prices.corporate_actions: splits change share counts on the ex-date; cash dividends (unadjusted per share) are paid to longs / charged to shorts on the ex-date in the ledger
prices.signal_series: log of a forward-built total-return index from unadjusted closes, splits and dividends, using only events dated <= t; vendor adjclose used only as a cross-check

screening.test: Engle-Granger (statsmodels coint, trend c, autolag AIC) on formation-window log TR indices, y on x; MacKinnon residual critical values
screening.select_if: pvalue < 0.05 AND beta > 0 within the window (unadjusted p; BH q reported, not used)
screening.also_report: Pearson correlation of levels and of daily log returns in formation window; half-life of formation spread

signal.spread: s_t = log TR_y - alpha - beta * log TR_x with alpha, beta from formation OLS (frozen for the trading window)
signal.stop_rule: after a stop-out no re-entry in the same trading window
signal.window_end: a flat signal is forced at the last trading-window close
signal.trade_time: 09:30 America/New_York open of the next trading day (lag 1)

sizing.leg_dollar_weights: long spread: w_y = 1/(1+|beta|), w_x = -beta/(1+|beta|) (A1); with the v2 selection rule beta > 0 for every traded window; short spread mirrored
sizing.shares: target shares = weight * NAV_at_signal_close / signal close price, rounded toward zero to whole shares; fixed until exit (no intra-trade rebalancing)
sizing.share_ratio_note: absolute share ratio |n_x|/|n_y| ~= |beta| P_y/P_x and signed ratio n_x/n_y ~= -beta P_y/P_x before whole-share rounding; after rounding only approximately

costs_scenarios_not_calibrated.impact: temporary only: eta * sigma20 * sqrt(shares / ADV20) with eta = 0.1, sigma20 and ADV20 from the 20 days ending at the signal close
costs_scenarios_not_calibrated.policy_rate: FRED DFF (effective federal funds rate), value of the prior available business day, ACT/360
costs_scenarios_not_calibrated.short_proceeds: credited to cash and earn the credit rate (rebate modelled through the cash rate)
costs_scenarios_not_calibrated.partial_fill_policy: matched: both legs filled at the smaller feasible fraction; the remainder is cancelled and logged

opening_fill_budget.adv20: mean unadjusted share volume over the 20 trading days ending at the signal close, restated to the fill day's post-split shares
opening_fill_budget.meaning: uncalibrated opening-fill scenario; not a realised participation guarantee
opening_fill_budget.post_close_diagnostic: fill-day full-day volume and |filled|/volume are recorded after the close and never change the 09:30 fill

costs_scenarios_not_calibrated.locate: every leg with negative target shares needs a locate (A2)

robustness_all_reported.always_trade_vs_screened: every pair also run ungated (traded in every window) to expose the selection effect
robustness_all_reported.partial_fill_stress: W0 = 1e9 per pair and independent-leg policy; budget still 5% of ADV20
robustness_all_reported.rule: grid results are descriptive; the headline uses only the frozen values above

evaluation.nav: N+1 daily NAV marks from W0 give N simple returns; annualisation 252
metrics: Sharpe on excess over credit cash rate
trade count, hit rate, holding days
evaluation.claim_rule: a positive headline must survive the cost grid and the selection-effect comparison to be called 'supported'; otherwise the report states that the evidence does not support the strategy

metrics_definitions.turnover: executed notional only: two-sided = sum |filled x fill_price|; annualised one-sided turnover = 0.5 x two-sided / mean daily NAV x 252 / N returns
metrics_definitions.episode: position-based: starts at the first fill leaving the flat state, ends at the fill returning both legs to zero; an entry order placed while a carried exit remainder is open joins the same episode (counted as a reentry)
metrics_definitions.win_rate: share of closed episodes with trading P&L > 0; trading P&L = fill cash flows - commissions + dividends - borrow while open (cash interest excluded); missing when no closed episode
metrics_definitions.holding_days: trading days from the first fill date to the closing fill date of a closed episode; missing when none
metrics_definitions.open_episodes: counted separately; marked to the last close and excluded from win rate and holding days

disclosure.motivation: design scope (one long, one short relative-value pairs) and timing fixes found by the independent c4 acceptance (R01 opening-fill capacity used full-day volume known only after the close; R02 intraday borrow basis ignored the 09:30 open mark). The beta>0 rule is not adopted because negative beta cannot be hedged: a same-direction position can hedge a negative relation to first order. It narrows the project to the relative-value long/short design the course trains.
disclosure.not_changed: universe, sample dates, formation/trading/step days, EG test and p<0.05 level, z thresholds 2/0.5/4, sizing gross 1.0, all cost/borrow/financing scenario values and robustness grids

event_order: accrue to 09:30 on previous marks -> split -> dividend -> both legs marked at the 09:30 open -> fills -> accrue to 16:00 (borrow basis = open marks of actual holdings) -> close mark
